Your role

As a Customer Service Agent, you will be the main point of contact for customers, workshops and other parties involved. Your goal is to provide excellent customer service while ensuring that every case is followed up accurately and efficiently.

Your main responsibilities will include:

 
• 
Handling incoming phone calls and customer inquiries.

 
• 
Managing emails and providing clear and professional responses.

 
• 
Gathering information and checking data for accuracy and completeness.

 
• 
Providing first-line technical support and communicating with workshops.

 
• 
Keeping customers and all relevant parties informed about the progress of their case.

 
• 
Following up and monitoring agreements with all parties involved.

 
• 
Managing contract-related issues within the agreed deadlines.

 
• 
Managing several cases and tasks simultaneously while maintaining a high level of service.

Working hours

The position is Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturday work during particularly busy periods.

You will work in rotating shifts between 07:00 and 22:00.

Flexibility regarding working hours is essential for this position.

Your profile

We are looking for someone who is customer-focused, communicative and able to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

Knowledge & experience

 
• 
Very good English – essential for the position.

 
• 
Good knowledge of German.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Dutch.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.).

 
• 
Previous experience in administration, customer service or case management is a strong asset.

 
• 
Technical knowledge of the automotive sector, tyres or mechanics is a plus, but not required.

 
• 
No specific experience is required, as full training will be provided.

Skills & personality

 
• 
Excellent telephone communication skills.

 
• 
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

 
• 
Naturally customer-oriented and service-minded.

 
• 
Able to multitask and manage several cases at the same time.

 
• 
Accurate, organised and committed to delivering high-quality work.

 
• 
Stress-resistant and able to remain calm in challenging situations.

 
• 
Flexible and quick to adapt to new tools, procedures and situations.

 
• 
Reliable, motivated and eager to learn.

Are you commercially minded and do you enjoy working with customers? Are you looking for a job that is never the same and where you get opportunities to grow?

Then maybe you are our new CUSTOMER CARE REPRESENTATIVE!

For our client, the largest private rail freight operator in Europe, we are looking for a customer care representative to join the Freight Force.

As a customer care representative you will: Process owner for the booking & check-in process
  
• You accept bookings on customer request  
• You make bookings yourself of containers and wagons on trains and you send the booking instructions and agreements to Order Management  
• You inform and make the customer acquainted with the Customer Portal so that he is able to makes his own bookings. You assist the customer in every step of the booking process.  
• You manage changes of the original booking  
• You check if basic commercial data is known and is supported via the Customer Portal. If no, you inform and request assistance from Inside Sales to amend lacking commercial information  
• You rectify the missing and/or wrong contract number for import orders to ensure quick O2C  
• You make sure that all booking details are correct and that there are no anomalies that can slow down the order-to-cash process  
• You prepare template of the railway bill/consignment note.  
• You make the consignment note (as a paid service or if in high special need for assistance)
Commercial tasks
  
• You are able to maximize the fill rate of each train by finding the extra box/wagon and by consulting the customer on a professional and commercial way (based on parameters of Commercial Margin Management)  
• You manage the customer relation daily and (pro-) actively to create a lock-in opportunity and retain Customer satisfaction.  
• You build a customer relationship through high standard service delivery and execution.  
• You highten awareness and inform the client of successful products  
• You inform and share knowledge with other stake-holders within the company to inform and update on this new transport relation
Customer behavior
  
• You discuss and try to understand the booking behaviors and needs of the Customer via commercial discussions based on KPI’s (in relation to SLA)  
• You sharing info about the customer behavior with commercial stake-holders (commercial Margin Management/Key accountmanagers/Inside Sales/...)
Communication
  
• You are pro-actively by thinking with the customer, assessing and acting before possible incidents.  
• You assure the tracking & tracing (within office hours) via Customer Portal and other ways (digitalization is key and our future aim)  
• You receive and assist the Customer with his complaint within our organisation and stakeholders

Who are we looking for?

As a Customer Service Representative, you are primarily focused on customer service. You have a commercial mentality and are able to communicate with the customer in a professional way.
  
• You have a bachelor degree or equivalent through experience;  
• You have strong communication skills and are able to understand and translate the customers needs;  
• You speak English fluently. A good knowledge of French and Dutch is required. Knowledge of German or another language is a plus;  
• You have experience in managing an account and you are able to work on customer relations and loyalty;  
• You have knowledge of the various Microsoft Office programs and are quick to learn proprietary systems;  
• You are organized, detail-oriented and have the drive to work in a commercial and professional manner;  
• You have the necessary persuasiveness and commercial flair, are proactive and can work alone as well as in a team;  
• You are a multitasker and are someone who values efficiency;  
• You can cope with a changing environment.

Our client is a dynamic and growing company in the region of Oostende.

Jobomschrijving

Understanding exactly what a customer needs is essential. Do you believe listening is just as important as speaking? Then keep reading!

A selection of your responsibilities:

• You respond to customer enquiries by telephone and email, identify customers' needs and provide clear, helpful and professional support.
• You ensure a smooth and accurate order flow, from receiving orders to invoicing.
• You create, update and maintain customer accounts and ensure that customer information is complete and accurate.
• You support customers with webshop enquiries, online ordering, account access and other website-related issues.
• You assist with the day-to-day aministration of online webshops, including order follow-up, customer questions and issue resolution.
• You register and handle returns, claims and complaints in a timely manner and propose ways to prevent recurring issues.
• You maintain up-to-date knowledge of products, prices, promotions, procedures and online information to resolve customer questions effectively.
• You mainly support B2C customers, while also assisting professional customers such as retailers and wholesalers with orders, service requests and online tools.

We are looking for the following profile:

• You are a native English speaker with excellent spoken and written communication skills.
• You are customer-focused, empathetic, flexible and a strong communicator.
• You are confident handling a high volume of telephone calls and emails while maintaining accuracy and service quality.
• You are comfortable using webshops, online platforms, Microsoft Office and customer or order-management systems.
• You can set priorities, organize your work and follow customer requests through to completion.
• You are enthusiastic, eager to learn and enjoy working as part of a team.
• You are comfortable with routine administrative tastks and maintain a positive approach in every customer interaction.
• You have a commercial mindset and know how to combine customer focus with result-oriented working.
• You are available for a full-time position.

Are you a proven buy-side M&A professional (3-7 years experience) looking for more than just another corporate deal-making role?Do you thrive in entrepreneurial environments, enjoy taking ownership, and want to play a key role in scaling an ambitious international platform?This is a unique opportunity to become the right hand of a successful entrepreneur and directly contribute to the development of a high-growth buy-and-build strategy across Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg.We are partnering with an international investment group active in the industrial services and utilities sector, currently pursuing an ambitious acquisition strategy across Europe. To support this growth, they are looking for a Lead Associate Benelux who combines strong transaction expertise with a genuine entrepreneurial mindset.The group focuses on acquiring and scaling specialised businesses operating in sectors such as:

• HVAC
• Industrial air and ventilation systems
• Environmental services
• Control and utility solutions
• Technical maintenance and industrial services
The role can be located everywhere in Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

As a Lead Associate (M&A) your responsibilities are:

• Contribute to merger and acquisition projects within the Accounting & Finance department.
• Review financial information to support transaction-related discussions and decisions.
• Prepare clear analyses and documentation for M&A activities.
• Coordinate financial data collection required for ongoing projects.
• Assess available financial information and highlight relevant findings.
• Work with internal stakeholders to ensure financial inputs are complete and consistent.
• Maintain organised records and supporting documentation for transaction work.
• Help ensure M&A activities progress in line with agreed priorities and timelines.

We are looking for someone who combines strong buy-side transaction experience with the mentality of an entrepreneur.You will typically have:

• 3 to 7 years of buy-side M&A experience
• Proven exposure to deal sourcing, target screening, due diligence and acquisition execution
• Fluency in Dutch, French and English
• Experience in industrial services, HVAC, ventilation systems or utilities is considered a plus but is not essential
More importantly, you are someone who:

• Has a strong entrepreneurial drive and growth mindset
• Is ambitious and eager to accelerate their career
• Enjoys operating in dynamic, fast-growing environments
• Is comfortable working with limited bureaucracy and high levels of autonomy
• Takes ownership and accountability for results
• Sees opportunities where others see obstacles
• Is naturally proactive and self-driven
• Possesses strong emotional intelligence and relationship-building skills
• Can earn the trust of business owners and entrepreneurs
• Communicates complex topics with clarity and confidence
• Combines strategic thinking with a hands-on approach
• Is humble, pragmatic and collaborative

We are currently looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist, fluent in French and English, to join a team based in Brussels.

In this temporary assignment, you will play a key role in supporting the full recruitment cycle within the professional services sector. Your responsibilities will include sourcing talent, screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and ensuring an efficient and positive hiring process.

Client Details

A professional services organisation based in Brussels.

Description

As a recruiter your responsibilities are:

 

• Source and attract candidates using various recruitment channels.
• Screen and shortlist applicants based on job requirements.
• Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers.
• Maintain and update recruitment databases and records.
• Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
• Provide support in contract preparation and onboarding processes.
• Collaborate with the HR team to meet recruitment goals.
• Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and procedures

• Bilingual in French and English (mandatory)
• Previous experience in recruitment is required
• Enjoys daily interaction with people while also appreciating administrative tasks
• Available immediately
• Temporary contract, with a potential opportunity for a permanent position

• Our partner is a well-established food manufacturing company delivering high-quality bakery products to international markets.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead and develop the quality organization, ensuring clear priorities, accountability, and team performance : 10 FTE (QA, QC & Safety).
• Manage and continuously improve the quality and food safety management system.
• Partner closely with Operations to identify risks and implement sustainable corrective actions on the production floor.
• Oversee HACCP, traceability, allergen management, supplier quality, product specifications, complaints, and product compliance.
• Coordinate internal and external audits and maintain certifications including BRC, IFS, RSPO, and FDA standards.
• Build strong relationships with customers, suppliers, certification bodies, and public authorities while promoting a culture of shared responsibility for quality and food safety.
• N 1 : Director Quality and R&D / N 2 : CEO

• Master's degree in Food Science, a scientific discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
• Minimum 10 years of experience in quality and food safety within the food industry.
• Proven experience managing, coaching, and developing teams.
• Strong expertise in quality management systems combined with a solid understanding of manufacturing processes.
• Professional communication skills in Dutch, French, and English, with a pragmatic and people-oriented leadership style.

Our client is a highly respected international law firm with a strong reputation for excellence and client service. With a collaborative and professional culture, the firm combines high standards with a supportive working environment where people are encouraged to take ownership and make an impact.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage the daily operations of the Brussels office
• Lead and support administrative and office services teams
• Oversee facilities, office maintenance, and workplace experience
• Coordinate suppliers, contractors, and external service providers
• Manage vendor relationships, tenders, and contract negotiations
• Monitor office budgets, expenses, and operational costs

The organisation operates in the retail industry in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As a Head Of People & Culture, you will play a strategic role in:

• Development of our employees and our company culture / Employer Branding
• Drive talent acquisition, development, and retention
• Supporting organizational transformation initiatives
• As a true business partner, you will collaborate closely with HR and commercial teams across all our brands, as well as with our headquarters, to continuously enhance the employee experience throughout the organization
• Work on Diversity & Inclusion projects
• 

A successful Head Of People & Culture should have:

• Strong capability in leading Human Resources activities.
• Experience translating business needs into practical people priorities.
• Ability to develop and maintain clear HR processes.
• Confidence working with stakeholders on people-related topics.
• Experience guiding the delivery of Human Resources initiatives.
• Ability to bring consistency to people practices across a business.
• Able to exchange in French, Dutch and English

We are a team of more than 74,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

Jobomschrijving

As part of the HR team, you will play a key role in supporting managers and employees on all operational and administrative HR matters. You will act as the first point of contact for Hard HR topics, ensuring compliance with local labour legislation, accuracy of HR data, and smooth execution of HR processes throughout the employee lifecycle.This position offers an excellent opportunity for an HR professional who wants to further develop expertise in Belgian labour law, HR administration, payroll coordination, and HR operations.Employee Lifecycle Management

• Manage and coordinate all administrative HR processes from onboarding to offboarding.
• Prepare employment contracts, contract amendments, and other employment-related documents.
• Follow up on employee movements, including promotions, transfers, changes in working time, and organizational changes.
Payroll & Compensation Administration

• Act as the main point of contact for payroll administration and collaborate closely with the payroll provider.
• Follow up on absences, leave requests, time registration, and benefits administration.
• Support compensation and benefits administration and related documentation.
Labor Law & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with Belgian labour legislation, collective labour agreements, and internal policies.
• Monitor legislative changes and support the implementation of required updates.
• Provide first-line guidance to managers and employees on contractual and administrative HR matters.
HR Operations & Data Management

• Maintain accurate employee data in HR systems (Workday and other HR tools).
• Ensure data quality, reporting accuracy, and compliance with GDPR requirements.
• Create and maintain HR procedures, policies, templates, and documentation.
Process Improvement

• Identify opportunities to improve HR processes and administrative efficiency.
• Support the digitalization and automation of HR activities.
Contribute to HR projects related to compliance, employee administration, and operational excellence.

• Master's degree, preferably in Human Resources, Business Administration, Payroll Administration or a related field
• Fluent in Dutch and French, both written and spoken; good command of English
• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in an HR generalist, HR operations or payroll-related role
• Good knowledge of local legislation (knowledge of Luxembourg legislation is a plus)
• Good knowledge of Office tools (Outlook, Excel, Power point)
• Knowledge of Workday is a plus
• Strong communication and presentation skills
• Strong analytical skills
• Comfortable working with digital HR systems, tools and process automation
• Results oriented
• Good administrative and organizational skills
• Open-minded, autonomous, flexible and proactive
• Able to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism

jobs.occupation: Technical Service Manager - Industrial Technology Leader
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international industrial technology group specializing in environmental solutions for highly regulated industries. To support the growth of its aftermarket activities, the company is looking for a Service Manager to lead service operations in Belgium, develop long-term customer relationships and drive recurring service revenue through maintenance, inspections and technical support.

• Lead and coordinate daily service activities across Belgium
• Plan and optimize technician schedules and field interventions
• Manage external contractors and service partners
• Conduct technical inspections and customer visits
• Identify improvement opportunities and prepare service proposals
• Develop and expand maintenance and service contracts within existing accounts
• Ensure high service quality, safety and customer satisfaction
• Support the future growth of the service department and service offering

For our customer in Houthalen we're searching for an Estimating Engineer.

Your key responsibilities:

• Conducting detailed analysis of project specifications and drawings to accurately estimate costs associated with materials, labor, and equipment
• Determine cost estimate targets during the design and development process, recommending cost effective solutions
• Working cross-functionally with project managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to gather comprehensive details for precise estimation

• Reviewing bids from subcontractors and vendors for conformity to project requirements and overall budgetary constraints
• Implementing best practices in cost estimation and establishing protocols for regular updating and revising of estimates
• Establish cost estimates of production processes and tooling costs and review alternatives or put forward recommendations for improvement

• Investigate and identify cost reduction opportunities through cost analysis review
• Contribute to cost monitoring and reporting systems and procedures and monitor trends
• Prepare cost and expenditure statements, reports and other necessary documentation at regular intervals to share with others in the business
• Support all activities in cost estimating and take a proactive approach towards improvements
• Create sales layouts

• Relevant business or manufacturing/engineering degree preferred, BsC or MsC
• Some previous experience of cost estimating, ideally in an machine building, manufacturing or engineering environment
• Good IT systems knowledge and skills including advanced SAP and Excel skills
• Ideally experienced in the use of spreadsheets, estimating pricing models and cost management tools
• Able to show evidence of adding value and cost optimization
• Knowledge and understanding of a variety of manufacturing/automotive processes and components and ability to evaluate and analyze associated costs
• Experience in manufacturing and design environment, mechanical engineering
• Knowledge of 3D design software (Inventor, AutoCAD)
• Knowledge of various production techniques: milling, turning, welding, sheet metal working, assembly
• Good knowledge drives
• Willing to travel
• Bilingual (Dutch-English)
